entries.title: Intervals `A..B` and `A..`
entries.text: `A..B` matches A up to and including B; both bounds are integers, B >= A or the command exits 2 with `error: empty interval 'A..B'`. `A..` has no upper bound. Output: one matched line per input line, unchanged, in input order.

entries.title: Unit names
entries.text: Accepted unit names (sweep S01): km m cm mm in ft. Any other name: stderr `error: unknown unit 'X'`, exit 2. Names are case-sensitive (`KM` is rejected).

entries.title: Unclosed quote
entries.text: A pattern with an unclosed `"` exits 2 with `error: unterminated string at column N` (N is 1-based, points at the opening quote).
